title: Running Spring Boot on AWS runtimes
prompt: How do ECS/EKS, Lambda, and plain EC2 change Spring Boot operations?
answer: Containers favor graceful shutdown, health probes, and memory-aware JVM settings; Lambda favors fast startup, cold-start mitigation, and stateless handlers.
